Job Description:

About Berklee
At Berklee, we believe that creativity is a powerful force for change, and we are committed to inspiring and cultivating the next generation of music and performing arts leaders. We value innovation, student-centered learning, and collaboration across diverse disciplines. As a globally recognized institution, we provide an environment that fosters professional growth, continuous learning, and work-life balance, all while driving impactful, mission-driven work that transforms the future of music education.

Role Overview
Berklee is seeking a dynamic, experienced Senior Workday Solutions Architect to join our team. In this critical role, you will be the Berklee technical lead for projects and ongoing technical support for our Workday platform, including Workday Human Capital Management (HCM), Payroll, Financial Management, Adaptive, Extend, Prism, Learning, and Student modules. Your expertise will guide Berklee through system enhancements, integrations, and troubleshooting, ensuring the continued success of our Workday environment.

This position will require close collaboration with stakeholders across the institution and the opportunity to mentor the Workday technical team. As part of Berklee’s Information Technology Services (ITS) team, you will be a key player in shaping the technological solutions that power our community's academic and administrative systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design of Workday solutions across multiple modules (e.g., HCM, Finance, Payroll, Adaptive, and Student) to align with the Workday platform goals and long-term roadmaps.

  • Oversee and own the overall technical architecture, ensuring security, scalability, and performance

  • Collaborate with technical leads in Workday HCM, Finance, Adaptive, and Student modules to develop and implement system architecture and protocols.

  • Design, build, and maintain Workday custom reports, integrations, and dashboards in alignment with Berklee’s goals and data security frameworks.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, ensuring data consistency and security across all Workday modules.

  • Partner with Berklee Enterprise technical team to support the integration between internal Berklee systems to maintain data integrity and system architecture alignment

  • Troubleshoot complex issues, conduct impact analyses for Workday updates, and provide expert guidance

  • Assist with the development and execution of a comprehensive Workday data governance program.

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Workday’s products and best practices, and contribute to system optimization and enhancements.

·

Who You Are
You are a seasoned professional with 5-8 years of experience working with the Workday platform, including experience with Workday Financials, Adaptive, and Workday Student. You bring a strong technical background and have a passion for problem-solving, troubleshooting, and driving system improvements. You thrive in a collaborative, student-centered environment and are adept at managing competing priorities while providing exceptional service to stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years of related professional experience, with at least 3 years of experience in Workday Finance report writing.

  • Experience with Workday HCM, Financials, Adaptive, and Student modules (Workday Student experience is a plus).

  • Strong experience with Workday Studio, BIRT, Core Connector, API calls, and advanced calculated fields.

  • At least three Workday Pro certifications required, with a preference for certifications in Financials, Integrations, and Reporting.

  • Experience with data governance and reporting/integration processes.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Ability to work independently and proactively with a high degree of initiative.

  • BA in a technology-related field or commensurate professional experience.

Why Berklee?
At Berklee, we believe in work-life balance and a culture of inclusivity, creativity, and collaboration. We offer a supportive environment that encourages professional growth and development, with opportunities to mentor others and lead complex technical projects. As a Berklee employee, you will be part of a dynamic and innovative institution that places a strong emphasis on student success and community impact.

Benefits and Perks

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.

  • Generous paid time off, including holidays, vacation, and sick leave.

  • Flexible work environment: Primarily remote with occasional on-campus meetings at Berklee’s Boston campus.

  • Access to professional development resources and training.

  • Opportunities to attend Workday training and conferences.

  • Collaborative and inclusive work culture with a focus on innovation and creativity.

Hiring Range:
$150,000 - $180,000; salary dependent on relevant experience and education.

Please visit the Total Rewards page to learn more about the benefits of working at Berklee.

raw.title: Solutions Engineer - DroneSense
raw.excerpt: The Company Versaterm is a global public safety solutions company helping agencies transform how they serve their communities.
raw.description:
The Company

Versaterm is a global public safety solutions company helping agencies transform how they serve their communities. Since 1977, we’ve been building an ecosystem of intuitive tools designed for public safety agencies, forensic labs, court systems, schools and other institutions. Through purposeful integrations and a selective growth strategy, we focus on improving workflows to help our customers achieve more efficient operations, better service and more just outcomes.

Our teams are driven by innovation, expertise and an unwavering commitment to customer success. As we continue to grow and expand our ecosystem, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to solutions that enhance community safety and transform the future of public safety technology. If you’re passionate about making a meaningful difference, we’d love to hear from you.

We are seeking a passionate and skilled Solutions Engineer to join our growing team. As a key member of the revenue organization, you’ll play a critical role in enabling customer success through technical excellence, operational execution, and pre-sales strategy. You will collaborate with our regional sales teams to deliver high-impact product demonstrations, guide prospective customers through technical trials, and contribute to the strategic growth of our public safety customer base.
This role requires deep familiarity with Drone as a First Responder (DFR) programs and a working knowledge of FAA regulations governing BVLOS (Beyond Visual Line of Sight) operations. Your expertise will help public safety agencies navigate complex regulatory environments while deploying cutting-edge drone programs that save lives and enhance situational awareness.

What You Do

  • Partner for Regional Growth Collaborate with a regional team—including Account Executives and Inside Sales—to meet or exceed territory revenue goals.
  • Subject Matter Expert Act as a trusted technical advisor in your territory, identifying key regions, high-impact agencies, and strategic “influencer accounts.” Emphasize your knowledge of DFR concepts and FAA BVLOS requirements to educate and support public safety partners.
  • Product Demonstrations Deliver clear, compelling, and customized demonstrations of the DroneSense by Versaterm platform tailored to agency mission needs—especially for DFR use cases and operational scale.
  • Trial Success Management Guide agencies through technical trials, ensuring they experience measurable success and understand platform value, with attention to real-world constraints around BVLOS flight, airspace, and risk mitigation.
  • Sales Enablement Work closely with Marketing to create and deliver impactful sales collateral. Share best practices and insights to improve win rates.
  • Engage with the Field Represent DroneSense by Versaterm at public safety conferences, regional “fly days,” agency workshops, and on-site demos—bringing deep operational awareness of DFR deployments and airspace integration.
  • Strategic Collaboration Partner with Sales leadership to refine go-to-market strategy, drive adoption in priority markets, and elevate customer satisfaction.
  • Compliance and Industry Awareness Stay current on FAA regulations—including those governing Part 107 waivers, tactical BVLOS, and COAs—and support agencies pursuing advanced drone programs aligned with evolving policy.

What You Bring

  • 3+ years of experience in UAS technical sales, support engineering, or drone operations (e.g., DJI, Parrot, Autel, docked systems, MavLink).
  • Working knowledge of DFR program design and FAA regulatory pathways for BVLOS operations.
  • Proven ability to communicate complex technical and regulatory concepts to a wide range of audiences.
  • Self-starter with the ability to execute independently or in collaboration with others.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred).
  • Passion for supporting first responders and a commitment to public safety innovation
  • Ability to travel up to 50%

Preferred

  • Experience with public safety, emergency response, or defense environments.
  • Direct experience supporting DFR programs or obtaining FAA waivers/COAs.
  • FAA Part 107 certification and operational flying experience.
  • Prior work with drone-related SaaS platforms.

Versaterm does not use AI in the recruitment process. All stages of recruitment decisions are lead by people, including our qualified acquisition team and our experienced hiring managers.

Versaterm is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to equity, diversity, inclusion, and a barrier-free workplace. Accommodations are available upon request throughout all stages of the recruitment process and apply to the terms and conditions of employment. For more information, please contact info@versaterm.com.

raw.description:
At Mitel, you will have the opportunity to help businesses connect, collaborate and provide better experiences for our customers. You will deliver valuable contributions in creating business success within our global organization utilizing your unique attributes, skills and experience.

Please take a moment to look over this opportunity and if interested, feel free to send us your application. If this is not the right opportunity for you, you can also sign up for Job Alerts by creating an account. This will give you a profile that you can use for all future applications, and you will be notified whenever a new position that matches your criteria becomes available.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Enterprise Sales Engineer to partner closely with Sales Executives in acquiring net new enterprise customers. This role is focused on winning new business, not expanding existing accounts. You will play a pivotal role in the sales cycle — from discovery to technical validation and solution design — ensuring our unified communications solutions meet the complex needs of large enterprise customers.

Your expertise will drive technical credibility, help differentiate our platform, and ultimately close deals with new enterprise customers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with the account representative to strategize, plan, and execute pursuits of net new enterprise accounts.
  • Lead technical discovery sessions to understand customer infrastructure, requirements, and pain points.
  • Design and present tailored solution architectures, leveraging deep product and industry knowledge to align with customer goals.
  • Conduct live demonstrations, proof-of-concepts (POCs), and technical workshops that showcase value and drive customer confidence.
  • Serve as the trusted technical advisor throughout the sales cycle, addressing security, integration, and scalability questions.
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Product, Engineering, Marketing) to ensure customer feedback is represented and solutions are optimized for enterprise-scale deployments.
  • Develop and deliver compelling technical presentations for both business and IT stakeholders.
  • Assist in creating competitive positioning and technical win strategies for target accounts.
  • Support RFPs/RFIs by crafting accurate, persuasive, and technically sound responses.
  • Stay current on industry trends, emerging technologies, and the competitive landscape in unified communications and enterprise collaboration.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a Sales Engineer, Solutions Consultant, or Pre-Sales Engineer in an enterprise B2B technology environment.
  • Proven success supporting new customer acquisition (hunter motion) in large or strategic enterprise accounts.
  • Experience working with Cisco and Avaya.
  • Strong understanding of unified communications or related enterprise platforms.
  • Deep technical knowledge in networking, voice, video, APIs, and integrations with enterprise IT ecosystems.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills; able to simplify complex concepts for executive and technical audiences alike.
  • Experience designing and delivering proofs of concept (POCs) and managing technical evaluations.
  • Ability to thrive in a high-velocity, competitive environment with a focus on new business growth.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or relevant work experience

Preferred:

  • Familiarity with enterprise security and compliance standards (e.g., SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP).
  • Experience with collaboration and contact center technologies.
  • Technical certifications (e.g., CCNP, AWS, Azure, or equivalent vendor certifications).
  • Master’s degree in Engineering or Business

Attributes for Success

  • Hunter Mindset: Energized by chasing and winning new logos, not maintaining existing ones.
  • Storyteller: Able to connect technology to real-world business outcomes.
  • Collaborator: Works seamlessly with Sales, Product, and Customer Success to ensure a unified customer experience.
  • Strategic & Tactical: Can both design the vision and dive into the technical weeds to deliver it.

raw.title: Software Engineer, iOS Core Product - Pasadena, USA
raw.excerpt: The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
raw.description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its App of the Day.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

With the growth of our iOS app, being the #18 productivity app in the App Store category and also our recent recognition as Apple's 2025 Design Award for Inclusivity, we find the need for a Senior iOS Engineer to help us support the new user base as well as work on new and exciting projects to push our missing forward.

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week.

What You’ll Do

  • Opportunity to lead key engineering and product decisions
  • Actively shipping production code for the Speechify iOS app
  • Work within a dedicated product team
  • Participate in product discussions to shape the product roadmap
  • Maintain and enhance the existing complex app architecture

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • Experience. You've worked on products that scaled to a large user base
  • Track record. You have worked on various products from inception to decent traction. You have been responsible for engineering the product
  • Customer obsession. We expect every team member whose responsibilities directly impact customers to be constantly obsessed about providing the best possible experience
  • Product thinking. You make thoughtful decisions about the evolution of your product and support internal teams and designers into taking the right direction
  • Speed. You work quickly to generate ideas and know how to decide which things can ship now and what things need time
  • Focus. We’re a high-growth startup with a busy, remote team. You know how and when to engage or be heads down
  • Technical skills. Swift, SwiftUI

Technical Requirements:

  • Swift Programming Language
  • SwiftUI experience
  • Experience in Multithreading Programming
  • Working with CI/CD infrastructure
  • Experience with Fastlane
  • SOLID principles, the ability to write every single class according to SOLID
  • Experience with Git and understanding of different Git strategies

What We offer:

  • A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product
  • An entrepreneurial crew that supports risk, intuition, and hustle
  • The opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry
  • A competitive salary, a collegiate atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture
  • Work on a product that millions of people use and where daily feedback includes users sharing that they cried when they first found the product because it was so impactful on their lives
  • Support people with learning differences like Dyslexia, ADD, Low Vision, Concussions, Autism, and Second Language Learners, and give reading superpowers to professionals all over the world
  • Work in one of the fastest growing sectors of tech: Intersection of Artificial Intelligence and Audio

The United States Based Salary range for this role is: 140,000-200,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Refer them!
